hits.text: Aug 10, 2024 · Learn how they work. Vaccines help the body learn how to defend itself from disease without the dangers of a full-blown infection. The immune response to a vaccine might cause tiredness and discomfort for a day or two, but the resulting protection can last a lifetime. Infections are unpredictable and can have long-term consequences.
